# Papercuts — jpegxl-rs

Small frictions hit while working, logged in the moment (D-027). None of these blocked anything; together they show where the project needs sanding down. Newest first.

- 2026-08-07 [claude] knowledge.complete's cited evidence gets its observed_at commit hash from the current git HEAD at write time, which is the *parent* commit if the record and its evidence are still uncommitted -- so `akr check`/`knowledge.validate` after the eventual `git commit` flags V-020 "evidence predates last content change" even though the evidence genuinely verifies the committed content. Workaround used twice this session: after committing, add a second evidence record (re-running the same cheap check) and re-run knowledge.complete citing it, then `akr build`. A cleaner fix might be an explicit `observed_at` override accepted post-hoc, or docs telling agents to commit code before the propose/evidence/complete sequence rather than after.  `@jpegxl-rs.papercut.knowledge-complete-s-cited-evidence-gets-its/1`
- 2026-08-06 [grok-4.5] Opt-F multiplicity counters are still only listed in PERFORMANCE.md — no feature-gated EncodeStats in policy/encode — so flamegraphs cannot yet separate repeated DCT from expensive DCT.  `@jpegxl-rs.papercut.opt-f-multiplicity-counters-are-still-only/1`
- 2026-08-06 [grok-4.5] jpxl bench fingerprints outputs with FNV-1a-64, but PERFORMANCE.md baselines require a cryptographic hash of codestream and binary; need --sha256 or a post-pass so promotion is not hand work.  `@jpegxl-rs.papercut.jpxl-bench-fingerprints-outputs-with-fnv-1a-64/1`

Always use -e cpu_core/cycles/u and taskset to P-cores for reusable flamegraphs.  `@jpegxl-rs.papercut.hybrid-intel-plain-cycles-u-records-cpu-atom/1`
